svg.title: RUN IT BACKWARDS
svg.desc: A 64 by 22 field of a reversible cellular automaton (Critters). Its first frame looks like static, but it is the sentence "NO BUG / IS RANDOM" 80 steps early: the same rule, applied forward, reassembles the words cell for cell, holds them, and plays back to the static. Generated by scripts/render_entropy.py.
